risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (394.56), flat yield curve with recession signals, and recent FOMC event create severely adverse macro conditions for financials; 52-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Volume spike (15x), CMF cross-up, and OBV bullish signal accumulation at extreme fear levels (VIX crisis) with price near support (54.22), offering contrarian bounce potential.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price rejected below all major moving averages (9/20/21/50/200 EMA/SMA), MACD bearish, ADX weak (21.68), Ichimoku below cloud, macro environment in crisis (VIX 394.56, flat yield curve, high credit spreads), zero fundamental catalysts, and 52-day earnings risk—technical structure and macro headwinds overwhelm volume signals.
